scope: Mutation targets: src/transaction.py, src/fraud_engine.py. wad18.py and csl.py are shared dependencies validated in their own capsules and excluded from this run.

equivalences.proof: src/ is already importable when tests run; insertion index 0 vs 1 resolves the same modules (no duplicate module names on the path).

The guard follows `n < MIN_HISTORY_FOR_OUTLIER or ...`, so it is evaluated only when n >= 3. Transaction enforces amount_cents >= 1, so total >= 3. Both `total == 0` and `total == 1` are therefore always False when reached; the guard is unreachable and the mutation is unobservable.
